name: Synn
message: "Huh? What is this...? This smell... could it be―"

name: Nanaka
message: "Two-egg bacon and eggs. Two slices of crustless bread slathered with margarine. Mashed potatoes made from organically grown potatoes."

name: Synn
message: "Why is that all in past tense?!"

name: Nanaka
message: "Plus a hundred-item fresh salad with non-oil dressing. Orange juice, 100% fresh-squeezed straight from the orchard. And for dessert, of course―"

name: Synn
message: "Munch munch... delicious! Seconds! ―Thanks for the meal!"

name: Misa
message: "Why are you looking away!? I want you to stare more!!"

name: Synn
message: "Then first, kindly close those lovely bare legs of yours. I hardly know where to look."

name: Misa
message: "Oh... I suppose I wouldn't mind if it were you... Eep, I said it\s04"

name: Lolotte
message: "Excuse me. Mr. President, if you would like, please have this."

name: Synn
message: "A bento? Could it be, for me?"

name: Lolotte
message: "First tier: a full osechi course, packed with herring roe. Second tier: the three-part harmony of tempura rice, eel rice, and pork cutlet rice."

name: Lolotte
message: "Then the climax: the third tier, the pinnacle of Japanese cuisine―nigiri sushi piled with salmon roe and sea urchin. And to crown it all, dessert. Which is―"

name: Lolotte
message: "Hee hee. Was it to your liking?"

name: Synn
message: "Early-morning breakfast is the best!! Thank you for the meal!!"

name: Lolotte
message: "Thank you for eating so much. Mr. President"

name: Ria
message: "I have no money. So I can't buy a single thing."

name: Ria
message: "Anpan, jam bread, curry bread, melon bread, yakisoba bread, omusoba bread, uguisu bread, two-color bread, and a baguette. All of it."

name: Synn
message: "And to finish it off, a musk melon!!"

name: Synn
message: "What!? Meteors are falling from the sky!?"

name: Synn
message: "This is bad. At this rate, everyone will be in danger..."

name: Synn
message: "Phew... today's student council activities ended without a hitch. Now, time to have fun~~"

name: Synn
message: "All-you-can-sing, all-you-can-drink. Let's have ourselves a blast!! Let's live our youth to the fullest!!"

name: Synn
message: "Nothing beats a beef steak for dinner. The knife glides right through, and the juices come bursting out."

name: Synn
message: "Did you all know? 'Bifuteki' is short for 'beef steak'."

name: Synn
message: "Heh heh. Keep that up and the beef will get cold."
Since when is bifuteki this watery―
